summary: SFL Corp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 11, 2026. The meeting re-elected directors, reappointed auditors, and approved board remuneration. A shareholder proposal to redesignate authorized shares as preference shares and authorize their issuance was voted against. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present; the filing is a routine corporate governance update. Foreign private issuer filing mapped to U.S. equivalent 8-K for shareholder meeting results.
